name: Woolly Pride: a fed Ealdfrost Yak can be fed again after 60 seconds (#10706)
contract: Issue #10706. Woolly Pride 175133 needs five Ealdfrost Yaks 164420 fed; seven stand in the Nivelarn stables.
Feeding is the Feed Yak spell click 9978001. The yak's SmartAI credits the feeder, removes its click flag and
restores it through timed event 1, authored as 'Create Timed Event 1 (60 s)'. Expected: the yak is not
clickable right after a feed nor 30 s later, and is clickable again once the 60 s timer has run.

steps.label: Join world phase 1, where the yaks are
SETUP: the client is told the nearest yak can be clicked
SETUP: Yaks fed counts one yak
CONTROL: the fed yak is no longer clickable
CONTROL: the fed yak is still not clickable after 30 s
DISCRIMINATING: the fed yak is clickable again after 60 s
